name: Theme Modal UI
description: Theme palette picker dialog. Radio button groups for base theme (Default/Monokai/Idol) and mode (Dark/Light). Apply commits to theme singleton and closes. Preselected to current theme state.

dom.root: .modal-overlay (position: fixed, display: flex/none, inset: 0, background: var(--scrim), align-items: center, justify-content: center, z-index: 10000)

elements.modal: .modal (role=dialog, aria-modal=true, background: var(--surface), border: 1px dashed var(--border), border-radius: 8px, padding: 24px, min-width: 340px)
elements.modal-header: .modal-header (font-size: 12px, font-weight: 700, letter-spacing: 3px, color: var(--tertiary), text-align: center, margin-bottom: 16px, text: 'THEME')
elements.modal-label: .modal-label (font-size: 9px, font-weight: 700, letter-spacing: 1px, color: var(--tertiary), margin-bottom: 8px, text: 'THEMES' or 'LIGHT / DARK')
elements.modal-radio: label.modal-radio (display: flex, align-items: center, gap: 8px, padding: 6px 0, cursor: pointer, font-size: 13px, color: var(--primary), font-family: 'Space Mono', 'Courier New', monospace) containing input[type=radio]

interactions.name: select_base
interactions.action: Update checked state for radio group (default/monokai/idol)
interactions.result: Base selection stored in DOM, no preview

interactions.name: select_mode
interactions.action: Update checked state for radio group (dark/light)
interactions.result: Mode selection stored in DOM, no preview

interactions.name: apply
interactions.action: Read checked radio values → theme.setTheme(base, mode) → close() → Fire onCloseCb
interactions.result: Theme applied globally via CSS custom properties, modal closed

interactions.name: cancel
interactions.trigger: click on #theme-cancel OR click on .modal-overlay (target === overlay) OR Escape key
interactions.action: close() → Hide overlay → Remove Escape listener → Fire onCloseCb

states.open: Overlay display:flex, radios preselected to current theme.base and theme.mode, Escape handler active. Re-rendered on each open() to reflect current state.
states.closed: Overlay display:none, onClose callback fired and cleared
